verses.sloka: सुसंरब्धं तु सौमित्रिं लक्ष्मणं क्रोधमूर्च्छितम्।रामस्तु परिसान्त्व्याथ वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् ॥ २.९७.१॥
verses.transliteration: susaṁrabdhaṁ tu saumitriṁ lakṣmaṇaṁ krodhamūrcchitam।rāmastu parisāntvyātha vacanaṁ cedamabravīt ॥ 2.97.1॥

translations.english: Thereafter, Rama pacified Lakshmana, son of Sumitra who was violently agitated. He said to him who had swooned with rage:

verses.sloka: किमत्र धनुषा कार्यमसिना वा सचर्मणा।महेष्वासे महाप्राज्ञे भरते स्वयमागते ॥ २.९७.२॥
verses.transliteration: kimatra dhanuṣā kāryamasinā vā sacarmaṇā।maheṣvāse mahāprājñe bharate svayamāgate ॥ 2.97.2॥

translations.english: When sagacious Bharata of great strength has come here, where is the need for a bow or a sword or a shield.
translations.hindi: नदियों के तटों पर, पवतां के शिखरों पर तथा वनों में रीछ. चित्तल आदि वनवासी जन्तु विकल होकर इधर उघः भागते हुए देख पड़े

verses.sloka: पितु: सत्यं प्रतिश्रुत्य हत्वा भरतमागतम्।किं करिष्ऺयामि राज्येन सापवादेन लक्ष्मण ॥ २.९७.३॥
verses.transliteration: pitu: satyaṁ pratiśrutya hatvā bharatamāgatam।kiṁ kariṣऺyāmi rājyena sāpavādena lakṣmaṇa ॥ 2.97.3॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, having sworn that I would make father's word true, what shall I do with the kingdom earned slanderously by slaying Bharata who has come (to see me)?

verses.sloka: यद्द्रव्यं बान्धवानां वा मित्राणां वा क्षये भवेत्।नाहं तत् प्रतिगृह्णीयां भक्षान् विषकृतानिव ॥ २.९७.४॥
verses.transliteration: yaddravyaṁ bāndhavānāṁ vā mitrāṇāṁ vā kṣaye bhavet।nāhaṁ tat pratigṛhṇīyāṁ bhakṣān viṣakṛtāniva ॥ 2.97.4॥

translations.english: I shall never accept any wealth obtained by destroying kith and kin or friends which is akin to taking food prepared with poison.
translations.hindi: दशरथनन्दन महात्मा भरत जी गर्जन करती हुई विशाल चतुरंगिणी सेना के साथ प्रसन्न मन हो चलने लगे।! ३॥ सागरोधनिभा सेना भरतस्यु महात्मनः । महीं संच्छादयामास प्राइषि द्यामिवाम्बुदः

verses.sloka: धर्ममर्थं च कामं च पृथिवीं चापि लक्ष्मण।इच्छामि भवतामर्थे एतत् प्रतिश्रृणोमि ते ॥ २.९७.५॥
verses.transliteration: dharmamarthaṁ ca kāmaṁ ca pṛthivīṁ cāpi lakṣmaṇa।icchāmi bhavatāmarthe etat pratiśrṛṇomi te ॥ 2.97.5॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, on the oath of righteousness, I wish wealth and pleasure as well as this kingdom for the sake of you all.
translations.hindi: वहाँ की भूमि उन घोड़ों और बड़े बड़े हाथियों से ऐसी ढक गई थी कि, बहुत देरखुँतक दिखलाई ही नहीं पड़ी

verses.sloka: भ्रातऽणां सङ्ग्रहार्थं च सुखार्थं चापि लक्ष्मण।राज्यमप्यहमिच्छामि सत्येनायुधमालभे ॥ २.९७.६॥
verses.transliteration: bhrāta'ṇāṁ saṅgrahārthaṁ ca sukhārthaṁ cāpi lakṣmaṇa।rājyamapyahamicchāmi satyenāyudhamālabhe ॥ 2.97.6॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, I desire this kingdom only for the unity and happiness of my brothers. I swear on the weapon I hold.
translations.hindi: भरत जी जज बहुत दूर निकल गए, तब वाहनों को थके हुए देख बे संत्रिश्रेष्ठ वसिष्ठ जी से कहने लगे

verses.sloka: नेयं मम मही सौम्य दुर्ल्लभा सागराम्बरा।नहीच्छेयमधर्मेण शक्रत्वमपि लक्ष्मण ॥ २.९७.७॥
verses.transliteration: neyaṁ mama mahī saumya durllabhā sāgarāmbarā।nahīccheyamadharmeṇa śakratvamapi lakṣmaṇa ॥ 2.97.7॥

translations.english: O gentle Lakshmana, lordship of this earth with the sea as its garment is not difficult to obtain (for me). But I do not desire even Indrahood by unrighteous means.
translations.hindi: इस स्थान का जैसा रूप रंग देख पड़ता है और जेता कि इसके विषय में, मैंने सुन रखा है, इससे तो यही जान पड़ता है कि, हम लोग उस स्थान पर पहुँच गए, जो भरद्वाजजी ने अतलाया था

verses.sloka: यद्विना भरतं त्वां च शत्रुघ्नं चापि मानद।भवेन्मम सुखं किञ्चिद्भस्म तत् कुरुतां शिखी ॥ २.९७.८॥
verses.transliteration: yadvinā bharataṁ tvāṁ ca śatrughnaṁ cāpi mānada।bhavenmama sukhaṁ kiñcidbhasma tat kurutāṁ śikhī ॥ 2.97.8॥

translations.english: O protector of honour even if there were to be some happiness which I could enjoy without you, Bharata, and Satrughna, let it be reduced to ashes by fire.
translations.hindi: देखिये यह तो चित्रकूट पव 9 है और यह मन्दाकिनी नदी हे और यही वन है जो दूर से नील मेन्न की तरह देख पड़ता है

verses.sloka: मन्येऽहमागतोऽयोध्यां भरतो भ्रातृवत्सल:।मम प्राणात् प्रियतर: कुलधर्ममनुस्मरन् ॥ २.९७.९॥
verses.transliteration: manye'hamāgato'yodhyāṁ bharato bhrātṛvatsala:।mama prāṇāt priyatara: kuladharmamanusmaran ॥ 2.97.9॥

translations.english: O best among men, O valiant one I think Bharata who is affectionate towards his brothers and who is dearer to me than my life, must have returned to Ayodhya and has heard that I had been exiled along with you and Janaki, wearing barks and matted locks. Remembering the duties of the race with an afflicted mind and with agitated senses he has come here to see me. He has not come with any other intention.

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा प्रव्राजितं मां हि जटावल्कलधारिणम्।जानक्या सहितं वीर त्वया च पुरुषर्षभ ॥ २.९७.१०॥
verses.transliteration: śrutvā pravrājitaṁ māṁ hi jaṭāvalkaladhāriṇam।jānakyā sahitaṁ vīra tvayā ca puruṣarṣabha ॥ 2.97.10॥

translations.english: O best among men, O valiant one I think Bharata who is affectionate towards his brothers and who is dearer to me than my life, must have returned to Ayodhya and has heard that I had been exiled along with you and Janaki, wearing barks and matted locks. Remembering the duties of the race with an afflicted mind and with agitated senses he has come here to see me. He has not come with any other intention.
translations.hindi: यह देखिए, जिस प्रकार वर्षाकाल में सजल श्यानल मेघ मण्डल जल बरसाता है, उसी प्रकार चित्रकूट के वृक्ष, हाथियों की सूड़ों के आघात से हिल क्र, पबत कें शिखरों पर फूना की वर्षा कर रहे हें

verses.sloka: स्नेहेनाक्रान्तहृदय: शोकेनाकुलितेन्द्रिय:।द्रष्टुमभ्यागतो ह्येष भरतो नान्यथा गत: ॥ २.९७.११॥
verses.transliteration: snehenākrāntahṛdaya: śokenākulitendriya:।draṣṭumabhyāgato hyeṣa bharato nānyathā gata: ॥ 2.97.11॥

translations.english: O best among men, O valiant one I think Bharata who is affectionate towards his brothers and who is dearer to me than my life, must have returned to Ayodhya and has heard that I had been exiled along with you and Janaki, wearing barks and matted locks. Remembering the duties of the race with an afflicted mind and with agitated senses he has come here to see me. He has not come with any other intention.
translations.hindi: हे शत्रुघ्न ! किन्नरों से सेवित स्थान की तरह, इस चित्रकूट पर्वात का देखो । जिस प्रकार समुद्र मै मगर घूमा करते हैं, उसी प्रकार इस पचात पर जिधर दखों उधर मृग समूह्‌ शोभार्यमान हो रहा है

verses.sloka: अम्बां च कैकयीं रुष्य परुषं चाप्रियं वदन्।प्रसाद्य पितरं श्रीमान् राज्यं मे दातुमागत: ॥ २.९७.१२॥
verses.transliteration: ambāṁ ca kaikayīṁ ruṣya paruṣaṁ cāpriyaṁ vadan।prasādya pitaraṁ śrīmān rājyaṁ me dātumāgata: ॥ 2.97.12॥

translations.english: Auspicious Bharata, angry with Kaikeyi and having spoken to her unpleasant, bitter words and having propitiated our father, has come here to offer me the kingdom.
translations.hindi: शरत्कान में जिस प्रकार वायु के वेग से प्ररित मेघसमूह आकाश में सुशोभित होता है उसी प्रकार हमारी सेना से प्रेरित हो यह सृगसमूर शोभायमान हो रहा है

verses.sloka: प्राप्तकालं यदेषोऽस्मान् भरतो द्रष्टुमिच्छति।अस्मासु मनसाप्येष नाप्रियं किञ्चिदाचरेत् ॥ २.९७.१३॥
verses.transliteration: prāptakālaṁ yadeṣo'smān bharato draṣṭumicchati।asmāsu manasāpyeṣa nāpriyaṁ kiñcidācaret ॥ 2.97.13॥

translations.english: Finding the time appropriate, Bharata has come to see us. Even in his mind he would have never thought of causing any harm to us in any way.
translations.hindi: जिस प्रकार दक्षिणी लोग श्रपते मध्वो को फूल को मालाओं से सज्ञाप्रा करते हैं--उप्तो प्रकार हमारे सेनिकों ने कुसुम के गुच्छो से अपने मस्तक सजा लिए हैं

verses.sloka: विप्रियं कृतपूर्वं ते भरतेन कदा नु किम्।ईदृशं वा भयं तेऽद्य भरतं योऽत्र शङ्कसे ॥ २.९७.१४॥
verses.transliteration: vipriyaṁ kṛtapūrvaṁ te bharatena kadā nu kim।īdṛśaṁ vā bhayaṁ te'dya bharataṁ yo'tra śaṅkase ॥ 2.97.14॥

translations.english: Why are you suspicious of Bharata? Has he done anything disagreeable to you any time in the past?
translations.hindi: हे शत्रुघ्न ! देखा यह भयानक वन पहले कैसा साँय साँय करता था किन्तु इस समय मेरो सेना को भोड़भाड़ से यह अयोध्या जैसा मालूम पड़ता है

verses.sloka: नहि ते निष्ठुरं वाच्यो भरतो नाप्रियं वच:।अहं ह्यप्रियमुक्त: स्यां भरतस्याप्रिये कृते ॥ २.९७.१५॥
verses.transliteration: nahi te niṣṭhuraṁ vācyo bharato nāpriyaṁ vaca:।ahaṁ hyapriyamukta: syāṁ bharatasyāpriye kṛte ॥ 2.97.15॥

translations.english: You must not speak any harsh or unpleasant words against Bharata. If you do, they will be deemed to be directed against me.
translations.hindi: घोड़ों के सुमा और बैज्ञों के खुरों से उड़ाई हुई धूल आकाश में छा जाती है। किन्तु पवन उसे शीघ्र ही हटा देता है, मानों. आँखों के सासने की रुकावट दूर कर, ( राम कीं पणशाला दिखा कर ) मुझे प्रसन्न करना चाहता है

verses.sloka: कथं नु पुत्रा: पितरं हन्यु: कस्याञ्चिदापदि।भ्राता वा भ्रातरं हन्यात् सौमित्रे प्राणमात्मन: ॥ २.९७.१६॥
verses.transliteration: kathaṁ nu putrā: pitaraṁ hanyu: kasyāñcidāpadi।bhrātā vā bhrātaraṁ hanyāt saumitre prāṇamātmana: ॥ 2.97.16॥

translations.english: Whatever be the calamity, O Lakshmana, how will sons slay their father, or a brother kill his own brother who is as dear to him as his own life?
translations.hindi: हे शत्रुघ्न ! देखो, ये घोडे सारथी सहित रथों को लिए हुए इस बन में कैसे तेजी से दौड़े चले जा रहे हैं

verses.sloka: यदि राज्यस्य हेतोस्त्वमिमां वाचं प्रभाषसे।वक्ष्यामि भरतं दृष्ट्वा राज्यमस्मै प्रदीयताम् ॥ २.९७.१७॥
verses.transliteration: yadi rājyasya hetostvamimāṁ vācaṁ prabhāṣase।vakṣyāmi bharataṁ dṛṣṭvā rājyamasmai pradīyatām ॥ 2.97.17॥

translations.english: If you are saying all these words only for the sake of the kingdom, then I shall ask Bharata when I see him to offer this kingdom to you.

verses.sloka: उच्यमानोऽपि भरतो मया लक्ष्मण तत्त्वत:।राज्यमस्मै प्रयच्छेति बाढमित्येव वक्ष्यति ॥ २.९७.१८॥
verses.transliteration: ucyamāno'pi bharato mayā lakṣmaṇa tattvata:।rājyamasmai prayaccheti bāḍhamityeva vakṣyati ॥ 2.97.18॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana if I earnestly exhort Bharata to offer this kingdom to you, then on hearing those words, he would say, 'Certainly so'.

verses.sloka: तथोक्तो धर्मशीलेन भ्रात्रा तस्य हिते रत:।लक्ष्मण: प्रविवेशेव स्वानि गात्राणि लज्जया ॥ २.९७.१९॥
verses.transliteration: tathokto dharmaśīlena bhrātrā tasya hite rata:।lakṣmaṇa: praviveśeva svāni gātrāṇi lajjayā ॥ 2.97.19॥

translations.english: Having heard the words uttered by his brother, Rama of virtuous disposition, Lakshmana who was devoted to his brother's welfare, shrank.

verses.sloka: तद्वाक्यं लक्ष्मण: श्रुत्वा व्रीडित: प्रत्युवाच ह।त्वां मन्ये द्रष्टुमायात: पिता दशरथ: स्वयम् ॥ २.९७.२०॥
verses.transliteration: tadvākyaṁ lakṣmaṇa: śrutvā vrīḍita: pratyuvāca ha।tvāṁ manye draṣṭumāyāta: pitā daśaratha: svayam ॥ 2.97.20॥

translations.english: Hearing the words of Rama, Lakshmana was abashed and said I think it is our father, king Dasaratha who has come here personally to see you.

verses.sloka: व्रीडितं लक्ष्मणं दृष्ट्वा राघव: प्रत्युवाच ह।एष मन्ये महाबाहुरिहास्मान् द्रष्टुमागत: ॥ २.९७.२१॥
verses.transliteration: vrīḍitaṁ lakṣmaṇaṁ dṛṣṭvā rāghava: pratyuvāca ha।eṣa manye mahābāhurihāsmān draṣṭumāgata: ॥ 2.97.21॥

translations.english: Observing Lakshmana's abashment, Rama said I think the mightyarmed king Dasaratha has come to see all of us here.
translations.hindi: भरत जी का ऐसा वचन सुन, अपने अपने श्रां को हाथ में लिए हुए बीरों ने वन में प्रवश किआ और कुछ ही दूर जा कर, एक स्थान पर उन्हाने धूर्माशखा देखी

verses.sloka: अथवा नौ ध्रुवं मन्ये मन्यमान: सुखोचितौ।वनवासमनुध्याय गृहाय प्रतिनेष्यति ॥ २.९७.२२॥
verses.transliteration: athavā nau dhruvaṁ manye manyamāna: sukhocitau।vanavāsamanudhyāya gṛhāya pratineṣyati ॥ 2.97.22॥

translations.english: Or rather having thought of the adversities of dwelling in a forest and also by realising that both of us are accustomed to comforts, I think he has certainly come to take us back home.

verses.sloka: इमां वाप्येष वैदेहीमत्यन्तसुखसेविनीम्।पिता मे राघव: श्रीमान् वनादादाय यास्यति ॥ २.९७.२३॥
verses.transliteration: imāṁ vāpyeṣa vaidehīmatyantasukhasevinīm।pitā me rāghava: śrīmān vanādādāya yāsyati ॥ 2.97.23॥

translations.english: Our father, the prosperous Dasaratha, after withdrawing this princess Vaidehi who is brought up in luxury from the forest (to Ayodhya), will return.
translations.hindi: यदि शत्रु दमनकारी पुरुषसिंह श्रीराम तथा बलवान्‌ लक्ष्मण न भी हों, तो श्रीराम के समान कोई अन्य तपस्वी यहाँ रहते हैं ( अर्थात्‌ यदि श्रीराम न भी हों तो वहाँ चलने से श्रीराम के रहने के स्थान का पता ता अवश्य ही चल जायगा )

verses.sloka: एतौ तौ सम्प्रकाशेते गोत्रवन्तौ मनोरमौ।वायुवेगसमौ वीर जवनौ तुरगोत्तमौ ॥ २.९७.२४॥
verses.transliteration: etau tau samprakāśete gotravantau manoramau।vāyuvegasamau vīra javanau turagottamau ॥ 2.97.24॥

translations.english: O valiant warrior, you can see those two splendid horses of high pedigree, charming, swift and equal to wind in speed are shining (in the army).
translations.hindi: साधुसैन्यः--उचिताः सैनिकाः । (गा२) २ प्रतिष्ठन्तां--गच्छु न्त्वित्य थे (गो०) ३ धूमाग्रं-धू-ंशिखां । (गे।०) क पांठान्तरे-- मन्ये वा० ग०-०५८ तच्छ ला भरतस्तेषां वचनं साधुसम्मतम्‌ । सेन्यानु्राच सवोस्तानमित्रबलमदेनः

verses.sloka: स एष सुमहाकाय: कम्पते वाहिनीमुखे।नाग: शत्रुञ्जयो नाम वृद्धस्तातस्य धीमत: ॥ २.९७.२५॥
verses.transliteration: sa eṣa sumahākāya: kampate vāhinīmukhe।nāga: śatruñjayo nāma vṛddhastātasya dhīmata: ॥ 2.97.25॥

translations.english: There is that huge and aged elephant named Satrunjaya which belogns to our sagacious father proceeding at the head of the army.

verses.sloka: न तु पश्यामि तच्छत्ऺत्रं पाण्डरं लोकसत्कृतम्।पितुर्दिव्यं महाबाहो संशयो भवतीह मे ॥ २.९७.२६॥
verses.transliteration: na tu paśyāmi tacchatऺtraṁ pāṇḍaraṁ lokasatkṛtam।piturdivyaṁ mahābāho saṁśayo bhavatīha me ॥ 2.97.26॥

translations.english: I do not see, O long-armed one! that splendid white canopy of my father, well-respected by men. And this gives rise to doubts in my mind.
translations.hindi: जब भरत जी ने उनसे इस प्रकार कहा, तब वे सब उसी पर इधर उधर ठहर गए । तदनन्तर भरत जी ने उस ओर देखा, जिस ओर घुआं उठता दिखलाई पड़ता था

verses.sloka: प्रथममर्धमुत्तरार्धेन योजनीयम् ॥ २.९७.२७॥
verses.transliteration: prathamamardhamuttarārdhena yojanīyam ॥ 2.97.27॥

translations.english: Get off the treetop, O Lakshmana, and do what I say said the righteous Rama.

verses.sloka: अवतीर्य्य तु सालाग्रात्तस्मात्स समितिञ्जय:।लक्ष्मण: प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा तस्थौ रामस्य पार्श्वत: ॥ २.९७.२८॥
verses.transliteration: avatīryya tu sālāgrāttasmātsa samitiñjaya:।lakṣmaṇa: prāñjalirbhūtvā tasthau rāmasya pārśvata: ॥ 2.97.28॥

translations.english: Lakshmana, the conqueror of foes, descended from the top of the sala tree and stood by the side of Rama with folded palms.

verses.sloka: भरतेनापि सन्दिष्टा सम्मर्दो न भवेदिऺति।समन्तात्तस्य शैलस्य सेना वासमकल्पयत् ॥ २.९७.२९॥
verses.transliteration: bharatenāpi sandiṣṭā sammardo na bhavediऺti।samantāttasya śailasya senā vāsamakalpayat ॥ 2.97.29॥

translations.english: Let not the hermitage be crowded commanded Bharata, and the army encamped around the mountain.

verses.sloka: अध्यर्द्धमिक्ष्वाकुचमूर्योजनं पर्वतस्य सा।पार्श्वे न्यविशदावृत्य गजवाजिरथाकुला ॥ २.९७.३०॥
verses.transliteration: adhyarddhamikṣvākucamūryojanaṁ parvatasya sā।pārśve nyaviśadāvṛtya gajavājirathākulā ॥ 2.97.30॥

translations.english: Bharata's army full of horses, elephants and chariots covering a distance of more than one and a half yojanas encamped by the side of the mountain.

verses.sloka: सा चित्रकूटे भरतेन सेना धर्मं पुरस्कृत्य विधूय दर्प्पम्।प्रसादनार्थं रघुनन्दनस्य विराजते नीतिमता प्रणीता ॥ २.९७.३१ ॥
verses.transliteration: sā citrakūṭe bharatena senā dharmaṁ puraskṛtya vidhūya darppam।prasādanārthaṁ raghunandanasya virājate nītimatā praṇītā ॥ 2.97.31 ॥

translations.english: The army brought by Bharata, the great moralist, was shining around Chitrakuta mountain following dharma, and casting off all pride, in order to please Rama. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे सप्तनवतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the ninetyseventh sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
